name: Cosigning
overview: Scripture warns believers about the dangers of cosigning loans, portraying it as a risky commitment that can lead to personal loss and bondage. Proverbs cautions against striking hands or becoming surety for others, especially strangers, highlighting the potential for hardship and regret (Proverbs 6:1; 11:15; 17:18). The borrower is depicted as a servant to the lender, emphasizing the seriousness of debt obligations (Proverbs 22:7), and believers are urged to avoid entangling themselves in such financial surety agreements (Proverbs 22:26). These teachings encourage wise stewardship and caution in financial dealings within the community.
